author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In this live stream excerpt, Adam Savage answers a question from Tested member Ariel Teran, who has started a corporate job in a big company and wonders if she's in the right place. Thank you for your question and support, Ariel, and good luck with your future endeavors! Have you ever faced this sort of struggle with your own job?
